ruleDefinitions.name: Guest Account Enabled Via Sysadminctl
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to enable the guest account using the sysadminctl utility

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/sysadminctl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-guestAccount.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ on.*")))
